name: Hook of Hamate Fracture
definition: Fracture of the hook of hamate, often caused by gripping sports or direct trauma and capable of irritating the ulnar nerve or flexor tendons.

investigations.principle: Carpal-tunnel view radiographs may miss injury; CT is highly useful for diagnosis.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Symptomatic nonunion or high-demand athletes may require excision/fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the hook of hamate, often caused by gripping sports or direct trauma and capable of irritating the ulnar nerve or flexor tendons.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
